task_description: Install Google Tag Manager (container GTM-N6BF7NP7) into the live public-v6 SvelteKit portal so GTM, and the GA4 + Microsoft Clarity tags it fires, start receiving data. GTM was completely absent from the site, which is why all three dashboards are empty. Add the GTM head <script> + <body> <noscript> iframe in app.html, SSR-safe SPA page-view tracking via afterNavigate in the root layout, extend the strict vercel.json CSP so GTM/GA/Clarity are not blocked, and add source-scan + unit tests. Scope strictly to Public/frontend-v6; no new npm dependency; keep check 0/0, tests green, build within budget.

review.non_blocking_concerns: All three are GTM-container-side config, not code defects: (1) GA4 pageview double-count unless container disables built-in pageview; (2) possible Clarity *.clarity.ms worker-src/frame-src allowance if a live load shows a CSP violation; (3) page_path/page_title are custom keys, GA4 expects page_location/page_referrer so a GTM variable mapping is needed. Surfaced to user in deploy/verify note.

verification.summary: npm run check 0 errors/0 warnings; npm test 326 passed across 21 files (incl. new gtm.test.ts + pageview.test.ts); npm run build succeeded and first-load-bytes budget gate passed at 371160 bytes (limit 700000). Test quality confirmed: gtm.test.ts source-scans both GTM placements in app.html, the CSP directives, and the layout afterNavigate wiring; pageview.test.ts exercises the real helper (asserts exact page_view push, no-op when dataLayer absent/non-array). Both would fail if the code were reverted. No Dockerfile for this app, so docker build skipped. Scope confirmed: diff touches only Public/frontend-v6 (+ .agents task state); package.json dependencies unchanged.
